review_role: Independent nonauthor source and handcrafted frozen-binary runtime review; no production/main-oracle changes and no Cargo
verdict: No blocking semantic, ownership, or encoder-design issue found within this review scope.
source_observations: Material fields and the finite private binding table own core slot paths; scalar and UV presence are preserved by cloning validated JSON and replacing only texture indices.
Selected and leaf image/texture/sampler closures retain logical identities, including shared images with different samplers. One channel writer follows a common prepared triangle corner order.
Raw extrema use all four components before semantic normalization; normalized integer UV/color conversion and VEC3 implicit color alpha agree with admitted component rules.
Whole-document primitive admission checks bound UV sets and counts. Payload caches distinguish accessor semantic roles and index accessor/POSITION-count contexts.

Conformal admission checks the accumulated world Gram matrix in metadata before dependency capture and staging. Reflections map tangent XYZ with the linear matrix, NORMAL with inverse transpose, and flip tangent W alongside the shared corner permutation.
The finite color range, authored normal/tangent requirement, mixed-W exclusion, and conformal bake restriction are bounded producer policies. No extra orthogonality condition is introduced.
Runtime, local resource binding, and image admission modules are unchanged from the baseline; material and vertex decisions remain in the pure source decoder.

Corrective metadata classification separates generic bounded accessor layout from semantic role validity. Admitted roles reject contradictory shape/component/normalization as InvalidInput; impossible FLOAT/u32 normalization is also InvalidInput. Post-role profile admission refuses unused signed, scalar-FLOAT, and matrix storage before dependency I/O, so none enters the scalar decoder or four-component extrema arrays.
proof_limits: Fresh runtime cases use the portable frozen CLI and one-leaf handcrafted fixtures. They do not independently claim multi-leaf browser lighting, native frontend, installed-wheel, lifecycle fault injection, or process resource measurements.

Eight checker controls corrupt decoded channel or material values in memory; they show sensitivity to plausible UV, handedness, color-alpha, lost-color, slot, and scalar mistakes, without mutating the producer.

Official Khronos validator and source-versus-output lit browser evidence are separate mandatory acceptance evidence. Their runners must supply receipts; this source/runtime review does not substitute for them.
The supplied build-input manifest was independently hash-checked against Git and the tree. This review did not rebuild the candidate or independently reconstruct the compiler dependency graph.

corrective_runtime_cases.details: Unnormalized unsigned COLOR and UV; unused signed byte/short, scalar-FLOAT, MAT4-FLOAT, padded MAT2-u8 and MAT3-u16; impossible normalized FLOAT/u32. Missing external buffer deliberately proves metadata-first classification; source bytes preserved and output/staging absent.
